instruction: Head straight down the hospital hallway, passing a nurse in a white coat on your right and the entrance to a room on your left. Continue forward through the exit doors leading outside. Once outside, move towards the glass bus shelter structure on the left side of the plaza. You will arrive at the umbrella located inside the glass shelter, near a parked ambulance with red and white stripes.

Exit the hospital room, passing the doctor in the white coat on your right. Move through the doorway into the outdoor area. You will enter a city street with tall buildings. Continue straight ahead on the pavement, keeping the red and white ambulance on your right side. Proceed forward towards the center of the street where a soccer ball is visible on the ground. You will arrive at the black shoes next to the soccer ball.

Start at the ambulance door and head outside, passing the white doorframe and moving onto the paved plaza. Slightly veer right, following the red and white ambulance on your left side. Continue forward across the plaza, keeping the ambulance alongside you. As you proceed, you will see a baby bottle lying on the ground ahead. This is your destination.

Turn right and exit the hospital building through the glass doors ahead. Once outside, follow the sidewalk past the ambulance on your right. Continue moving forward along the street, passing the white delivery van and the "Wellspring Pharmacy" storefront on your right. Keep going straight down the sidewalk, with the tall, dark building on your left and the lighter-colored buildings on your right. Proceed forward until you see a black top hat lying on the ground; the target glove is next to it.

Starting from a hallway, exit the building and proceed straight down the street, keeping the tall modern buildings on your left and the older, darker buildings on your right. Continue along the road past the ambulance parked on the left side. As you move further down the street, you will see a bright red diner called "Rockets Burgers" on your right. Approach the diner, and you will arrive at the dog standing near the entrance.

Start inside the hospital hallway, moving past the white-coated doctors. Exit the building through the automatic doors onto the city street. Follow the road straight ahead, keeping the tall grey buildings on your left and the darker structures on your right. Continue down the street, passing a white ambulance parked on the left side. Keep moving forward along the pavement until you spot a green rectangular object on the ground near a grey trash bag; you will arrive at the warm_blanket.

Start facing the doctor in the hallway with the reception desk on your right. Move forward past the doctor and exit the building through the open doorway ahead. As you exit onto the city street, turn right. Follow the road straight ahead, passing a red and white ambulance on your left and a tall grey building further down the street. Continue forward until you reach a Siamese cat standing near a blue object on the ground.

Start by turning right and moving down the white hospital hallway past the nurse in the white coat. Continue out the double doors into the open city square, heading towards the large white and red ambulance. As you approach the ambulance, make a right turn. Continue moving forward along the pavement, passing a small blue object on the ground. You will arrive at the red rice bowl.

Exit the hospital room with blue curtains and turn right into the hallway. Proceed forward through the corridor until you exit the building onto a city street. Once outside, follow the paved ground slightly left, moving towards the open city square with tall buildings in the background. Continue straight past the glass bus shelter structure on your right. As you pass the shelter, bear slightly right. You will arrive at the red and white umbrella situated near the glass structure.

Proceed down the road, keeping the clear glass bus stop structure on your left. As you move forward, you will pass a white building on the right with an ambulance parked in front of it. Continue straight past the bus stop until you approach a street corner near a pharmacy with a green cross sign. Turn slightly left towards the curb where a white delivery van is parked. You will arrive near the front bumper of the white van.

Start by turning left near the reception desk with the blue sign reading '导医台' and a person standing in front. Continue forward into a hallway where a person in a white lab coat is standing. Exit the building through the door into the street. Once outside, follow the road as you turn right, passing a red and white ambulance on your left. Continue down the street flanked by tall buildings. Turn right again at the intersection, heading towards the narrow alley between buildings. Move forward until you arrive at the green fleece blankets on the ground.

Start inside a hospital reception area with a blue desk labeled in Chinese characters. Walk forward, passing between the reception desk and a waiting area with seating on your left. Continue straight through the glass exit doors to leave the building. Once outside on the pavement, turn right towards a large red and white ambulance parked on the street. Head towards the ambulance, and you will arrive at the small beige cat standing near a blue object on the ground.

Start facing the blue reception desk, then turn left to exit the room. Move through the white corridor with the blue wall stripe and exit the building into the open city street. Follow the road straight ahead, keeping the tall buildings on your left and the ambulance parked on the right. Continue forward down the street past the ambulance. Eventually, turn right towards the sidewalk near the building corner. You will arrive at the ale_bottle, which is on the ground near a green object and a red bowl.

Head down the city street, keeping the large, dark buildings on your right and the taller skyscrapers on your left. Continue straight ahead, passing a white ambulance parked on the left side of the road. As you proceed, you will see a red storefront labeled "ROCKET BURGER" on your right. Keep moving forward along the pavement past the burger shop. Eventually, you will approach a white storefront labeled "CAPITAL TRUST BANK" on your right. Stop here; you will arrive at the purple baby stroller sitting on the sidewalk.
